page_title: NAP 1-1 UDI | Napoli v Udinese 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Noah Okafor (Napoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+4' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
89' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Udinese was in an offside position.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
89' A lofted cross from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Udinese have a corner.
87' It's time for a substitution. Noah Okafor (Napoli) comes on in place of David Neres.
87' Scott McTominay (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp will be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Billy Gilmour (Napoli) will replace Stanislav Lobotka.
81' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Oumar Solet is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
80' It is time for a substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) is on for Arthur Atta.
79' Juan Jesus (Napoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
79' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
72' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The game has come to an end for Frank Anguissa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) for Romelu Lukaku.
70' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is replacing Matteo Politano.
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Martin Payero (Udinese) replaces Sandi Lovric.
70' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' Scott McTominay (Napoli) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

64' That didn't go as planned! David Neres (Napoli) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Razvan Sava, who easily kept it out.
63' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
61' Arthur Atta (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
59' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
54' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
53' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) commits a foul and Livio Marinelli immediately signals a free kick.
50' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Udinese force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Alex Meret easily deals with the threat. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Arthur Atta (Udinese), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

40' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Alex Meret just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.

37' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Scott McTominay (Napoli), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the right post. The score changes to 1:0.
37' Napoli win a corner.
37' Half-chance! Matteo Politano (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Razvan Sava reacts well to snuff out the attack.
36' A rebound spins to Scott McTominay (Napoli) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
35' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
33' The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
30' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
28' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Great chance! Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot well wide of the right post.
20' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
17' Udinese get a corner.
17' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Alex Meret makes a simple save.
16' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul after Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' David Neres (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
11' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
8' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
7' A cross from a corner kick by Napoli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

7' A snap shot by Matteo Politano (Napoli) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Razvan Sava produces a good save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.

6' Scott McTominay (Napoli) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
3' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Alex Meret thwarts him with a nice save.
3' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
2' Napoli are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
1' The first half has just begun.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Livio Marinelli will referee today's match.
